handback.title: Adopter repos require Dokima's checks by the names GitHub shows
handback.summary: In an adopter's repo, Dokima's checks carry their callers' names, so the audit must ask for those names.
handback.user_story: An adopter's Setup issue asks main to require Dokima's checks under the exact names GitHub shows there.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter's repo holds the installed settings file, the audit wants all tests under the name GitHub shows there.
acceptance_criteria.words: the required check names will not match
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The installed settings are fixed text; repos without them keep today's names, already tested.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter's repo holds the installed settings file, the audit wants Acceptance criteria under the name GitHub shows there.
acceptance_criteria.words: the required check names will not match
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The installed settings are fixed text; repos without them keep today's names, already tested.

raises.label: Nested caller names
raises.text: Does GitHub name an adopter's checks after both callers, dokima then full-suite, before all tests? The plan assumes so.

raises.label: Card and updates
raises.text: The card and branch updates still look for the plain names. Leave them to their own issues? The plan does.
raises.evidence: `dokima/card.py:25` and `dokima/uptodate.py:20` match `all tests` exactly; #785 and #786 move them to settings.
